description_en: Adds IP entries to an access control list (ACL)
description_zh: 向访问控制策略组中添加IP条目
kebab_example: aliyun alb add-entries-to-acl --acl-id acl-hp34s2h0xx1ht4nwo0000 --acl-entries Entry=10.0.1.0/24 Description=test-entry --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddEntriesToAcl

fields.help_en:
The description of the ACL entry. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

You can add at most 20 entries in each call
fields.help_zh:
访问控制条目备注描述，长度为2~256个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、中文、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

单次调用最多支持20个访问控制条目
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The CIDR block in the ACL entry
fields.name: entry

parameters.help_en: The ACL entries that you want to add. You can add at most 20 entries in each call
parameters.help_zh: 添加的访问控制条目列表。单次调用最多支持20个访问控制条目
parameters.name: acl_entries

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会在访问控制策略组中添加IP条目。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
